# Krisala Hiranandani Master Township Hinjewadi, Pune — Complete Knowledge Base

## 1. Executive Identification & Corporate Entities
- Official Project Name: Krisala × Hiranandani Master Township
- Alternate Project Names: Hiranandani Pune, Hiranandani Hinjewadi, Krisala Hiranandani, The Colosseum Hinjewadi, Sector Arcadia Hinjewadi
- Joint Venture Partners:
  1. Hiranandani Communities (Founder & Chairman: Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani) — Leading developer with 40+ years legacy, renowned for Hiranandani Gardens Powai (250 acres) and Hiranandani Estate Thane (350 acres).
  2. Krisala Developers — Renowned Pune-based luxury residential developer known for structural precision and timely execution.
  3. Della Resorts (Founder: Jimmy Mistry) — Experiential luxury and polo club management partner.
- Canonical Web Domain: https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/
- Contact Telephone: +91 77440 09295
- Site Sales Experience Center Address: Krisala × Hiranandani Township, North Hinjawadi, Darumbre, Pune, Maharashtra 410506, India.
- Geo Coordinates: Latitude 18.5913° N, Longitude 73.7389° E.

## 2. Regulatory Compliance & MahaRERA Certifications
All sectors within the 105+ acre master development are registered under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 through the Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority (MahaRERA):
- Sector Arcadia (Neoclassical High-Rise): MahaRERA Registration No. PR1260002500600
- The Colosseum (Phase 4 Roman Landmark): MahaRERA Registration No. PR1260002600818
- Sector Everlyn (Eco-Lake Sanctuary): MahaRERA Registration No. PR1260002502438
- Authorised Channel Partner RERA Registration: A52100024102
- Official MahaRERA Public Verification: https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in/

## 3. Master Plan & Enclave Breakdown (105+ Acres)
The development is planned across five distinct residential and lifestyle enclaves:
1. Sector Arcadia:
   - Configuration: 2 BHK Smart Luxury (740 sq.ft. carpet) & 2 BHK Grand Neoclassical (825 sq.ft. carpet).
   - Target Audience: Tech professionals working in Hinjewadi Phase 1, first-time luxury homebuyers.
   - Price: Starting from ₹79 Lakhs all-inclusive.
2. The Colosseum (Phase 4):
   - Elevation: B+G+27 Iconic Roman architectural towers.
   - Configuration: 3 BHK Imperial (1,020 sq.ft. carpet) & 3 BHK Colosseum Racecourse View (1,180 sq.ft. carpet).
   - Target Audience: Senior executives and families seeking unobstructed views of the racecourse and mountains.
   - Price: Starting from ₹1.25 Crore all-inclusive.
3. Sector Icon:
   - Elevation: High-rise triad towers (Towers A, B & C) connected by sky lounges.
   - Configuration: Signature 3 & 4 BHK Sky Duplexes and Penthouses (1,850 to 2,400 sq.ft. carpet).
   - Price: Starting from ₹2.10 Crore to ₹2.65 Crore all-inclusive.
4. The Della Collection:
   - Product: 100 Exclusive Luxury Resort Villa Plots (1,500 sq.ft. to 3,500 sq.ft.).
   - Inclusions: Custom architectural designs by Jimmy Mistry / Della Design + full access to Della Adventure & Polo facilities.
   - Price: Starting from ₹1.80 Crore.
5. Sector Everlyn:
   - Product: Nature-centric residences facing a natural lake and 5-acre butterfly reserve.

## 4. Architectural & Engineering Highlights
- Structural System: 100% precision Mivan monolithic aluminum formwork concrete shear-wall construction for earthquake resistance, seismic stability, damp-proof longevity, and zero plaster cracks.
- Architecture Style: Signature Neoclassical timeless stone facade, towering Roman columns, sweeping pediments, ornate architraves, and symmetry.
- Green Ratio: Over 70% of the 105+ acre parcel is preserved for open landscaping, equestrian turf, water bodies, and sports avenues.

## 5. Exclusive Signature Amenities (52+ World-Class Facilities)
- 8-Acre Private Turf Racecourse & Equestrian Arena (First in India within a residential township)
- Della Adventure & Polo Club campus
- 40,000 Sq.Ft. Neoclassical Clubhouse featuring grand chandeliers and marble banquet halls
- Olympic-Sized Temperature-Controlled Swimming Pool & Resort Sun Deck
- Professional Equestrian Stables with trained thoroughbreds and riding instructors
- High-Street Boulevard Retail & Gourmet Cafes
- Dedicated 3-Tier Security with AI-assisted perimeter surveillance and 24/7 concierge

## 7. Comparative Benchmark vs Competitors
- vs Kolte Patil Life Republic: Krisala Hiranandani offers lower density, true equestrian lifestyle with an 8-acre racecourse, and Hiranandani's verified 55x Powai capital appreciation record vs high-density 400-acre mass housing.
- vs Godrej River Royale / Infinity: Krisala Hiranandani offers 105+ acres of integrated master-planned green space at ₹8,500/sq.ft vs Godrej standalone high-rises on 12–15 acres priced at ₹9,500+/sq.ft.
- vs Lodha Sylvan Hinjewadi: Krisala Hiranandani features neoclassical architecture and 100 private villa plots vs vertical glass towers.
- vs VTP Earth One: Krisala Hiranandani provides superior RERA carpet room dimensions and Della resort club access vs compact high-density micro-units.

## 8. Transit & Connectivity Corridors
- PMRDA 128m Ring Road: 5 Mins (Direct access connecting Hinjewadi to Baner and Chakan)
- Pune Metro Line 3 (Megapolis Circle): 7 Mins (Fast transit to Shivajinagar and Pune Railway Station)
- Mumbai-Pune Expressway (Urse Toll Plaza): 10 Mins (75-minute drive to Navi Mumbai International Airport NMIA)
- Hinjewadi Phase 1 & 2 IT Parks (Infosys, Wipro, TCS): 12 Mins signal-free commute
- Balewadi High Street / Jupiter Hospital / Aundh: 20–25 Mins
